d: The Timberwolves defeated the Grizzlies, 104-95 tonight in Minnesota. Jaden McDaniels contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 5 rebounds and 4 assists, with Ayo Dosunmu of the Timberwolves adding an additional 19 points (9-14 FG, 1-6 3P) in the game. Cedric Coward finished with a team-high 23 points along with 7 rebounds for the Grizzlies in the losing effort. The Timberwolves improve their record to 12-5 with the win, while the Grizzlies fall to 12-5 for the season.
